name: Salora International Limited
about: Salora International Limited engages in the manufacture, distribution, and marketing of consumer electronics primarily under Salora brand in India and internationally. It offers smart LED TV, washing machine, coolers, audio accessories, TWS ear buds, headphones, smartwatches, neckband smart watch, chargers, power banks, and mobile phones, etc. The company also provides speakers, such as WiFI, single and twin tower, soundbar, and multimedia. In addition, it distributes various information technology (IT), telecom, and audio products, as well as lifestyle products. Further, the company offers mobile cases and screen protectors under ZAGG brands; true wireless stereo ear buds under Defunc brand; insulated bottles, handy pots, food jars, and rice cookers under Zojirushi brand; and crystal vases, plates, glasses, and holders under Nachtmann brands. It serves the consumer electronics, telecom, IT, and lifestyle industries. The company was founded in 1968 and is based in New Delhi, India.
